primitive_accounting.existing_diagnostic: Untimed navigation replay verifies exact production visited set, ordered beam, output and expansion count; use it rather than create another tracer.
unmeasured: fraction of expansions discovering a final neighbor
primitive_accounting.oracle_ceiling: Three independent completion lists can collapse many serial expansions only if their union contains the query neighbors; H-A-2 tests that necessary condition before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Corpus and held-out query identity must remain separated; benchmark-specific serving logic prohibited.
Total storage includes graph, completion IDs, copied codes, metadata and scratch.
One graph edge set serves navigation and final enumeration.
Distance-count improvements are treated as time improvements despite serial memory dependence.
Every expansion needs its predecessor's selected candidate before issuing the next fetch.

seed_triage.Z2: Existing profile_search gives native phase counters; persistent-network surface is being audited by root. No duplicate adapter work.
seed_triage.A1_A2: Selected for inexpensive oracle kill test; nearest-neighbor-only completion is threatened by RoarGraph OOD evidence, making it the bias-check hypothesis.
seed_triage.A3: NavigationDiagnostic already exposes all admission/expansion events; next candidate if completion coverage fails, requires own card.
seed_triage.A4: Requires per-query effort curves; no main-line parameter sweep authorized; deferred pending event data.
seed_triage.A5: Code already prefetches all newly discovered neighbor rows together; multiple frontier expansions could differ but must prove latency headroom first.
seed_triage.A6: Prior low-level report rejected THP as main line on streaming, graph THP results lacked gains; do not repeat unchanged measurement.
seed_triage.A7: VGraph already separates compact traversal and residual rerank; variable per-vector refinement may differ, but decisive-rerank concentration is unmeasured.
seed_triage.A8: Query-projected construction already exists; flow-aware edge deletion remains unverified and needs transfer constraints.
